long_description: The board met recently and determined you qualify for a scholarship. This is not a full scholarship, but it provides a good start for your education.
In the last board meeting your name came up. You have been extended a work study grant. You can use it for tuition and book requirements this year.
Thank you for your promptness in sending us your payment now due for the loan we provided you last fall.
We were not able to extend a semester loan this year but please accept this grant to assist you with current expenses.
Your school tuition fees are now due. We were unable to provide you with a loan to cover the full amount. The remainder is now due.
Thank you for selecting to stay at our fine dormitory. The fee is due now.
We were not able to provide you with the full amount of the loan requested. However, here is what we could do for this semester.
We welcome you to our apartment complex for students attending the nearby college. Your fee is enclosed.
You have been accepted in our school work/study program. You are entitled to payment in full.
We were glad you could find the books you needed for this semester. Your bill is enclosed.
In order to participate in the on-the-road training class the fee is enclosed.
All grants and loans have been scheduled this year for other students. But here is a special aid we were able to assign to you as a grant.
We were glad you could work with us for this weekend evening events. It was appreciated. Please accept our thanks.
We are pleased to announce your successful completion of your current degree program.
